name: Extra Large Maps (prototype)
description: A prototype of a ~16 km x 16 km map: difficulty 11 with Super Helldive's enemies and objectives on a map twenty times its radius, in a world of 16,384 m. For testing what the engine does with a map this size; expect long loads and empty land. Unlocked with Super Helldive: press Difficulty Up past it on the war table. Turn Hell Forge Difficulty off first: only one mod can add level 11.
